resolutions.title: The per-commit cache sits in a per-run directory, and records can overwrite each other
resolutions.action: The CLI cache moves to <os.tmpdir()>/orbit-replay/cli/<sha>/ and the build worktree is removed after the pack (design D2, task 1.2); records are named by UTC time to the second with default label run, and the runner refuses an existing name (spec record requirement, design D7, task 1.5).

resolutions.title: The ceiling can be overshot by a session, and a session that ends without a result record is unhandled
resolutions.action: A session starts only when spend plus its case's max_budget_usd fits the ceiling; a per-case timeout_minutes (default 30) kills a hung session; a session with no result record counts its whole budget. Spec runner requirement (row, paragraph, two scenarios), design D7, tasks 1.5 and 3.1 and the proposal follow.

retired: Before each session the runner compares the spend so far
past which no further session starts

introduced.text: RESERVES the case
